acip: DPER NA RAB RIB CAN GYIS DMIGS PA'I SKRA SHAD LA SOGS PA RNAMS KYI GCIG NYID DANG, MANG PO NYID DANG, ZLUM PO NYID DANG, NAG PO LA SOGS PA'I PHYOGS SUN 'BYIN PAS,
english: Suppose, for example, that we worked very hard to attack the idea—held by individuals who have cataracts on their eyes—that the strands of hair that they were seeing were either just one alone, or some great number, or somehow rounded, or black, or anything else of the like.
